notes: Version 1.0.301 — your own payment link in the report (e.g. Redsys pay-by-link), correct sizes and dates from CSV lists with Path/Name columns, more reliable .acerep loading.
changelog: Your own payment link: besides Stripe and bank transfer, you can paste any payment link that already contains the amount — e.g. Redsys pay-by-link, PayPal, Revolut or your bank's pay-by-link. The client ticks the consents and goes straight to the payment page; the report shows which website it is. With only a link turned on, the program does not ask for an amount. Optional fixed link (e.g. paypal.me/…) filled in automatically.
CSV lists with Path;Name;Full Name columns (also with an Ext column): file sizes and dates are now read correctly, and names containing a semicolon no longer split into wrong folders.

More reliable .acerep loading: if the built-in SQLite library is blocked on a computer (usually by an antivirus), the program loads a backup copy. If it still fails, the message shows the exact cause and how to fix it.
Updated user guide in 6 languages (also as PDF), now with a video at the top showing every feature (subtitles in 9 languages).
